item.title: SHEMM Coach
item.description: Today, let's talk Medication. This one's simple: consistency beats intensity. A missed dose or a skipped routine doesn't need guilt, it needs a fix — same time, same place, every day, so it stops depending on willpower. Your day's got structure already, checkpoints and quiet moments built in. Use one of them as your anchor. Action: pick your next scheduled pause today, and take your medication right then.
